field_mappings.conversion: preserve; do not promote to canonical_trade_id without sufficient provenance
WIN/LOSS map directly; FAILED/ABORTED/REJECTED map to execution_status with outcome UNKNOWN
map only when producer unit meaning is verified
map with currency and fee provenance; otherwise null
retain captured/known timestamps; missing availability remains unknown
emit immutable evidence attachment; never rewrite decision-time evidence
explicit mapping only; invalid or ambiguous combinations are quarantined

identity_policy: Stored v1 payloads remain immutable. New v2 identities are additive and linked by an adapter receipt.
environment_policy: data_origin and execution_environment must agree; IMPORT remains transport only.
